context: A teacher walks a teen through a project
purpose: Teach: 引きずっ/報道陣/ピッチャー/鉄則/真っ向/共犯/深まっ/心拍

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、研究、過去を引きずって悩まず、新視点、入れましたね。
lines.en: Sakura — you've moved past old frustrations and brought in a fresh perspective to your research. That's clear.
lines.style: Warm, observant tone. Measured pace. Recognition without overstatement. The voice of a teacher who sees growth and reflects it back gently.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。発表会、報道陣が来る、と聞いて、緊張します。
lines.en: Yes. I heard the press is coming to the presentation, and I'm nervous about it.
lines.style: Soft opening. Earnest, a little exposed. The admission catches slightly — she's admitting the nerves without quite intending to. Slightly quickened pace on 'press coming.'

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 発表の中心、ピッチャー的役割、自覚していますね。
lines.en: You're aware you'll be at the center of it — the focal point everyone's looking at during the presentation.
lines.style: Steady, conversational. Light emphasis on 'center' — not daunting, just factual. A teacher confirming what she's observed, inviting agreement.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。論理の鉄則、守って書きました。
lines.en: Yes. I've kept the logic tight — followed all the rules when I was writing it.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Clipped slightly, efficient. The tone of someone who's prepared methodically. Pride underneath, held close.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 対立陣営と真っ向から、議論、できるようになりましたね。
lines.en: You can face off against opposing views now and actually debate them head-on. That's real growth.
lines.style: Genuine delight. Steady, unhurried. A small pause before 'real growth' — letting the weight of the observation land. The voice recognizing a threshold crossed.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: メディアと共犯にならない、独立した視点、保ちます。
lines.en: I won't let myself become complicit with what the media wants. I'm keeping my perspective independent.
lines.style: Quietly fierce. Measured, each word deliberate. Not defensive — principled. A young person stating what she will not compromise on, clearly aware of the stakes.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 考察、深まったところ、評価できます。
lines.en: Your analysis has genuinely deepened. I want you to know I see that.
lines.style: Warm, direct, slightly slower pace. The tone of a teacher making sure praise lands. Genuine and unsentimental — the kind of words that matter because they're rare.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 発表時、心拍、落ち着かせる練習、しています。
lines.en: During the presentation, I've been practicing how to keep my heart rate calm so I can think clearly.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact with underlying focus. Not rushed, but efficient — the tone of someone taking concrete steps. A hint of vulnerability: she's preparing, and that preparation matters.
